Hajdusamson New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Szeder utca 7, Hungary

Not demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries in Hajdúsámson, this site was established in 1864 and remained active until at least 1943. The community here split along two very different wartime paths in 1944: most were sent to Auschwitz, while a smaller group was first sent to forced labor in Austria and then to Theresienstadt by March 1945 — and largely survived. Of the roughly 30 survivors who returned after the war, none stayed, and the community was never re-established.
